findings.summary: Shape-invalid upgrade_reasons values can bypass fail-closed validation
findings.details: Both implementations validate upgrade_reasons only for eligible:false entries. An eligible:true entry can carry any invalid upgrade_reasons value without rejection. For eligible:false, the Bash `entry.get("upgrade_reasons") or []` and PowerShell `Test-PythonFalsy` paths incorrectly treat present null, false, zero, and empty-string values as an absent array, producing an ineligible:<id> trigger and exit 10 instead of the required fragment-invalid diagnostic and exit 2. This violates the documented fragment shape and AC-027. TEST-013i covers only a truthy scalar on an eligible:false entry, leaving these bypasses untested.

findings.summary: Required verification checks are currently failing and the contract is stale
findings.details: T-002.contract.json records required regression and placeholder-scan checks as passes:false. Its own comment also states that spec_revision pins an obsolete specification revision and must be reissued by a fresh quality-gate run. The placeholder evidence ends in failure without the required human acceptance in a quality-gate report. Consequently the submitted verification contract cannot establish a passing implementation against the current specification.

findings.summary: The protected implementation has not been applied
findings.details: The implementation report explicitly leaves the HUMAN APPLY STEP pending. The delivered checker and policy remain staged under human-copy, while the protected live check-risk-upgrade scripts and policy are unchanged. Therefore the human-copy application and post-copy verification required by the task's Done When and AC-010/AC-031 remain unsatisfied.
